annotations.title: Live stock and monthly flow for an area

description:
Supply and demand for an area in one call: live stock today (count,
    median days on market, new-home count) and the monthly flow — listings
    added and reduced, reduction share, new-home share, agent concentration,
    asking-to-sold on the registry-matched subset and days to completion.
    Read the basis sentences: the flow count is the never-reduced cohort; the
    live-stock series began 2026-09-05 and is forward-only.
    UK only. Free.
name: supply_demand
